hub_identity.reservation_rule: Reserve the ticket (atomic O_EXCL create) before writing runners, artifacts, data, or logs. Existing IDs are rejected across registry, JSONL, tickets, logs, artifacts, data, and runners.

hypothesis: candidate_pool: raw SEC Companyfacts deferred-tax-asset valuation allowance burden falling versus revenue may identify companies where future taxable income confidence is improving; liquid SPY-relative leadership then tests whether the market is beginning to price that accounting quality before a 10-trading-day continuation leg.

prediction.confidence_reason: Mechanism: a falling deferred-tax-asset valuation allowance is an auditor-reviewed accounting-quality field that can signal higher confidence in future taxable income. Related tax-burden and raw Companyfacts quality scouts were mostly rejected on old_thin/drawdown, so probability is low; this is materially different from effective tax rate, debt, impairment, lease, working-capital, and SBC threshold retunes.

execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $50M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes
execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing raw SEC valuation allowance, annual revenue, or pretax income facts, missing prior comparison point, stale facts, missing CIK mapping, missing OHLCV, missing next open, or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same raw SEC valuation allowance tag, filed-date PIT annual revenue/pretax context, liquid SPY-relative confirmation, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.
